item.title: Why don't more developers "use the platform"?
item.description:
📝 If it were just about third-party libraries versus platform APIs, though, then I don’t think it could fully explain the antipathy toward “use the platform. But for many developers, this sounds like fun. And for many of us, before APIs like <dialog> existed, this was how we learned the web platform.
🔗 Read more: https://nolanlawson.com/2026/10/03/why-dont-more-developers-use-the-platform/

item.title: We're going to need default hard budget caps on pretty much everything
item.description:
📝 An argument against this is that businesses don’t want their hosted applications to start throwing errors because some budget was exceeded. I think hard budget caps need to be the default. If a project’s usage reaches its spend limit, your project is paused for that month.
🔗 Read more: https://simonwillison.net/2026/Oct/3/default-hard-budget-caps/

item.title: Former SR-71 engineer talks NASA's Blackbird revival program
item.description:
📝 Trimble reported just this week that NASA had been talking to ex-SR-71 program personnel about coming back to work on the aircraft. That was a drag issue, obviously. SR-71 tail number 844 during its service with NASA.
🔗 Read more: https://www.twz.com/air/former-sr-71-engineer-talks-nasas-blackbird-revival-program
